name: Acalabrutinib (continuous, CLL/SLL)
disease: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia / small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL)
histology: chronic lymphocytic leukemia / small lymphocytic lymphoma

biomarkers.TP53: test at each line of therapy
biomarkers.del17p: test at each line of therapy
biomarkers.note: Test for del(17p) and TP53 mutation (and IGHV mutation status) before each line of therapy. Covalent BTK inhibitors (acalabrutinib, ibrutinib, zanubrutinib) are preferred and effective REGARDLESS of del(17p)/TP53 status and are a preferred option specifically for del(17p)/TP53-aberrant CLL, where chemoimmunotherapy is inferior and should be avoided. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), CLL/SLL, v2.2026, CSLL-4.

treatmentSetting: first-line and relapsed/refractory therapy for CLL/SLL requiring treatment
lineOfTherapy: first-line (Preferred, category 1) and second-line or subsequent therapy (Preferred, category 1) for CLL/SLL, with or without del(17p)/TP53 mutation

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: CLL/SLL meeting iwCLL indications for treatment (not asymptomatic early-stage disease)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, CSLL-3 (indications for treatment) and CSLL-4 (First-Line Therapy)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: del(17p)/TP53 testing performed; acalabrutinib is preferred for del(17p)/TP53-aberrant disease (avoid chemoimmunotherapy)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, CSLL-4 (CLL/SLL with del(17p)/TP53 Mutation: Acalabrutinib (continuous) +/- Obinutuzumab, Preferred)

drugs.name: Acalabrutinib

provenance.locator: CSLL-4 (First-Line Therapy: Acalabrutinib (continuous) +/- Obinutuzumab, Preferred, category 1); MS narrative (cBTKis are given continuously until disease progression)

drugs.notes: Acalabrutinib is given continuously (days 1 to 28 represent continuous daily oral dosing; a BTK inhibitor is not cycled), until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), CLL/SLL v2.2026. DOSE IS VERIFY: the provided source confirms continuous dosing but does not print the dose; the commonly cited product-label dose is 100 mg PO twice daily, which must be VERIFY-confirmed against the label before use (not asserted here). Acalabrutinib may be given with or without obinutuzumab (ELEVATE-TN).

supportiveCare: Continuous daily oral therapy; adherence is critical to maintaining disease control.
Monitor for atrial fibrillation, hypertension, bleeding, and infection (BTK-inhibitor class effects); acalabrutinib has a lower cardiac/bleeding signal than ibrutinib.
Avoid concomitant proton-pump inhibitors with the immediate-release formulation (absorption); manage per label.
Consider antiviral/antimicrobial prophylaxis per institutional practice.

monitoring: CBC with differential and platelets periodically
blood pressure and cardiac rhythm (atrial fibrillation) surveillance

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 non-hematologic toxicity or grade 4 hematologic toxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and resume acalabrutinib at a reduced dose per prescribing information after recovery; clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: acalabrutinib is a selective covalent BTK inhibitor (CLL/lymphoma chapters); dose not printed in the provided extract

guideline.locator: CSLL-4 (First-Line Therapy, Preferred: Acalabrutinib (continuous) +/- Obinutuzumab, category 1; both with and without del(17p)/TP53 mutation); CSLL-D 2 of 5 (Second-Line or Subsequent: Acalabrutinib continuous, category 1); MS (cBTKis given continuously until progression)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for continuous single-agent acalabrutinib in CLL/SLL (#73). Acalabrutinib is a Preferred, category 1 option in both first-line (CSLL-4) and second-line/subsequent (CSLL-D 2 of 5) therapy per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), CLL/SLL v2.2026, and is effective and preferred with or without del(17p)/TP53 mutation, where chemoimmunotherapy should be avoided. Modeled as continuous daily oral therapy (cycleLengthDays 28 for reporting, cycles null, days 1 to 28 = continuous) because a BTK inhibitor is taken continuously, not in discrete cycles. DOSE IS VERIFY: the provided sources confirm continuous administration but do not print the dose; per the hard grounding rule the dose is set to the literal VERIFY (the commonly cited label dose of 100 mg PO twice daily is noted for clinical context only and is not asserted from a cited source). verifyFields lists the VERIFY dose and the protocol stays at DRAFT. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
